scenes.setting: Above the fog (visions only: The Sun's prayer image with a monocled, python-coiled phantom riding his spirit): Amon is stowing away toward the gray fog itself — so Klein adapts the Book of Secrets' Blood Moon Sacrifice into a secret-deed ritual of the King of Yellow and Black, and tasks the unwitting Derrick with performing it
scenes.text_anchor: By residing in the Spirit Body of The Sun, he is waiting for the next Tarot Gathering

scenes.setting: In the City of Silver, Derrick bleeds himself for ink, paints The Fool's name and symbols on monster hide, and begins the chant — spirituality flowing into the crimson script
scenes.text_anchor: he used his own blood as ink, and he wrote the name of The Fool

scenes.setting: The whole fog trembles as the secret deed connects: the python-phantom lifts its monocled head, hunting the hidden channel — and Klein's eyes stop on the Sun Brooch
scenes.text_anchor: his gaze stopped at the Sun Brooch.
